text: rachel_marketing: Quick ask - we need a verified bench run for the launch post. Can runtime pair to validate methodology + artifacts this week? sam_runtime: I can. Do you want coldstart-only or warmup+steady comparisons? rachel_marketing: Both. Marketing will quote coldstart percentiles; engineering wants warmup vs steady deltas. Need a reproducible artifact pack. lee_runtime: We'll need the payload cohort, model revision, batch config, quant flag, and trace samples. jordan_data: Uploaded cohort -> gs://redwood-marketing/launch-cohorts/replication-v2.json (300 queries, stratified). olivia_growth: Also request embeddings sample for embed latency claim. Include text-gen + embed runs. sam_runtime: Plan: 1) 3 sweeps (warmup+steady) for fp16 + quantized variants 2) 5 coldstart single-shot runs 3) collect p50/p90/p95/p99, token counts, per-token cost 4) export traces for 30 random requests Command: ```./bench-run --cohort gs://redwood-marketing/launch-cohorts/replication-v2.json --model-revision 2026-03-20-sha2efgh --warmup 8 --samples 300 --variants fp16 quantized --out gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v2/``` rachel_marketing: Two asks: (A) README in output bucket listing exact CLI flags/runtime config, (B) CSV mapping request->trace id for press pack. lee_runtime: Will include heatmap of latency by token position and a simplified chart for the deck if you want. olivia_growth: Yes please - p50/p95 lines, ms axis. sam_runtime: First sweep tomorrow morning. ETA artifacts Tue 16:00 PST, will rerun if variance >5%. benchbot: job queued id=rb-20260324-88 expected ~2.5h per sweep benchbot: job_id=rb-20260324-88 completed. outputs: gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v2/run-20260324-88/overview.json sam_runtime: Uploaded README + CSV mapping: README: gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v2/run-20260324-88/README.md CSV: gs://redwood-marketing/bench-outputs/replication-v2/run-20260324-88/request_trace_map.csv rachel_marketing: Got it - reviewing now. If numbers match draft claim we'll proceed to PR. Thanks everyone :rocket:
